research_completeness_gates_before_candi: DAILY_OPPORTUNITY_CAPTURE_NON_REGRESSION: candidate measures full-universe executable opportunity, gross/net capture, missed opportunity, capture ratio, entry efficiency, exit efficiency, MAE, MFE, time-to-positive, MFE give-back, stop inefficiency, add-on contribution, transaction costs and miss reasons; material capture regression must be explained and rejected unless compensated by superior risk-adjusted portfolio economics

COMPONENT_ABLATION_ATTRIBUTION_COMPLETE: research/thesis, opportunity ranking, adaptive strategy selection, regime filtering, add-ons, partials, protection, runners, capital recycling, sizing, compounding, cross-asset ranking and campaign management are ablated where technically applicable and classified

COMPOUNDING_DECOMPOSITION_COMPLETE: normal compounding is compared with constant starting-equity sizing, constant nominal risk and constant valid exposure so underlying expectancy is separated from equity-base expansion
TEMPORAL_FALSIFICATION_PASS: candidate survives dedicated look-ahead, same-bar contamination, future-release, signal/execution timestamp, cross-asset synchronization and session-boundary tests

PARAMETER_ROBUSTNESS_BASIN_PASS: promoted parameter values sit inside a reasonably broad profitable/non-regressive neighborhood and are rejected if small perturbations create catastrophic or structurally unstable performance
